rider.title: My settings
rider.intro: Your weight, position and reference power make speed and resistance more accurate. Difficulty softens the climbs for beginners or lower-powered trainers.
rider.privacyAccount: These settings are saved on your account and found again on each of your devices. They are shared with nobody.
rider.privacyLocal: These settings stay on this device. Sign in to find them everywhere.
rider.weightHelp: With your kit. The heavier you are, the harder the climbs.
rider.bikeHelp: A road bike weighs 8 to 10 kg.
rider.positionHelp: The lower you are, the less the air slows you down: it matters most on the flat and downhill.
rider.ftpHelp: The power you can hold for about an hour. If you do not know it: 95 % of your best 20-minute average.
rider.ftpEstimateFrom: From your best 20-minute effort ({watts} W average, on {date}).
rider.ftpNone: Ride 20 minutes flat out in one go and save the ride: we will suggest an FTP.
rider.difficultyHelp: At 100 % you ride the real grade. At 50 %, an 8 % climb pedals like a 4 % one, and you move accordingly. Ideal to start or for a lower-powered trainer. The terrain you see stays the course's.

sync.error: Not saved on the account: will retry with the next change.

workout.intro: The trainer holds the workout's power whatever the grade. Without a workout, it follows the course's terrain.
workout.done: Workout done, the trainer follows the terrain again.
workout.unsupported: This trainer does not support ERG mode: back to grade simulation.
workout.needsTrainer: Connect an FTMS trainer to use ERG mode.

intro.pedal: Pedal a few turns: the trainer wakes up and starts sending power.
intro.resistance: Raise the grade: resistance should increase. It resets to 0 % when you leave the page.
